description: Pay a Xenarch pay-link by id (wrapped x402): fetches the link's payment envelope, settles EIP-3009 USDC on Base, and confirms the payment with the link. Use this for pay.xenarch.com/l/<id> links; use xenarch_pay for arbitrary x402-gated URLs. Pays from the agent wallet (USDC only, no gas needed).

link_id.description: The Xenarch pay-link id to pay

max_price_usd.description: Refuse to pay if the price exceeds this (default 1.00)

name: xenarch_pay_link
